Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then the Canaanite, king of Arad, dwelling in the south, heard that the sons of Israel had come by the way of the Atharim; and he fought against them, and took some of them captive.
translations.2: And the house of Israel vowed a vow to God, saying: 'If You deliver this people into my hand, I shall make their towns devoted property.'
translations.3: And God heard the prayer of the house of Israel, and delivered the Canaanite into their hands; and they made him and his towns devoted property, and they named that place Hormah.
translations.4: Then they journeyed from Mount Hor by the way of the Sea of Qulzum (Red Sea), to go around the land of Edom; and the souls of the people grew weary on the way.
translations.5: And they spoke against God and against Moses, saying: 'Why did you bring us up from Egypt to die in the wilderness, where there is no bread and no water? And our souls are weary of this light food.'
translations.6: And God sent among the people burning serpents; they bit them, and many of them died.
translations.7: And they came to Moses and said: 'We have erred, since we spoke against God and against you. Pray to God that He remove the serpents from us.' And Moses prayed for them.
translations.8: And God said to him: 'Make yourself a burning image, and raise it upon a standard; then every one who has been bitten, if he turns toward it in repentance, shall survive.'
translations.9: And Moses made a serpent of bronze, and raised it upon a standard; and it was that any person who had been bitten by a serpent — if he turned toward it in repentance, he remained alive.
translations.10: And the sons of Israel journeyed, and encamped at Oboth.
translations.11: And they journeyed from Oboth, and encamped in the open wastes of the crossings, in the wilderness that faces the direction of Moab, from the rising of the sun.
translations.12: And they journeyed from there, and encamped in the valley of Zared.
translations.13: And they journeyed from there, and encamped on the side of the Arnon which is in the wilderness, that goes out beyond the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is on the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorite.
translations.14: Therefore it is said in the Book of the Conquests of God: 'From the whirlpools of Qulzum, and from the valleys — even Arnon;
translations.15: and the outflow of the valleys, which inclines toward the inhabited place of Ar, and leans upon the border of Moab.'
translations.16: And they journeyed from there to the well, of which God had said to Moses: 'Gather the people, that I may give them water.'
translations.17: Then the house of Israel sang this song, and said: 'Rise up, O well!' — and they respond to it.
translations.18: 'A well which the chiefs dug, which the nobles of the people hollowed out, marked with their staffs.' Then they journeyed from that wilderness to the place of bestowal.
translations.19: And from the place of bestowal to the central valley; and from that valley to the place of the assemblies.
translations.20: And from there to the valley that is in the land of Moab, by the summit of the fortress that overlooks the face of the open waste.
translations.21: Then the house of Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying:
translations.22: 'I wish to pass through your land; and we shall not turn aside to any farm or vineyard, nor shall we drink water from a cistern — but we shall travel by the broad road, until we pass through your border.'
translations.23: But Sihon would not allow the sons of Israel to pass through his border; and he gathered all his people, and went out to meet them into the wilderness, until he reached Jahaz; and he fought against them.
translations.24: And they slew him with the edge of the sword, and took possession of his land from Arnon to Jabbok, as far as the sons of Ammon — for the border of the sons of Ammon was strong and high.
translations.25: And they took all these towns, and settled in all the towns of the Amorites — in Heshbon and its surrounding districts.
translations.26: For Heshbon is the seat of Sihon king of the Amorites; and he had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land from his hand as far as Arnon.
translations.27: Therefore those who speak in parables say: 'Enter Heshbon, that the town of Sihon may be built and established.'
translations.28: 'For a fire went out from Heshbon, and a flame from the town of Sihon; it consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the marketplaces of Arnon.'
translations.29: 'Woe to you, O Moab! How you are undone, O worshippers of Chemosh! He has made his sons captives and his daughters taken prisoner — to the Amorite king Sihon.'
translations.30: And their mark has departed from Heshbon as far as Dibon, and desolation has spread to Nophah, which is near Medeba.
translations.31: And when the house of Israel settled in the land of the Amorites,
translations.32: Moses sent people to reconnoiter Jazer; and they captured its surrounding districts, and drove out the Amorites who were in them.
translations.33: Then they turned and went up by the way of the Bashan; and Og king of the Bashan came out to meet them — he and all his people — to battle, at Edrei.
translations.34: And God said to Moses: 'Do not fear him, for I am delivering him into your hand — and all his people and his land. Do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites who dwelt in Heshbon.'
translations.35: And they slew him and his sons and all his people, until not a survivor remained to him; and they took possession of his land.
